title: How to Grow Spiritually When Depressed
fullTitle: Soul Snack #17: How to Grow Spiritually When Depressed
description: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary explores the profound challenges and opportunities depression offers on the spiritual journey . Drawing on his own experiences and insights, Gary reframes depression not just as an overwhelming state of fear but as a chance to develop emotional awareness and authentic power. Through tangible steps, he guides listeners to look beyond the pain and find a path forward rooted in love and connection.
These feelings manifest as physical sensations in the body, and identifying them is the first step toward healing.

The solution lies in shifting attention from self-focused pain to loving actions. By committing to small, meaningful gestures—like offering a smile or helping someone else—listeners can break the grip of depression and rediscover the joy of connection and purpose. The key is acting from the loving parts of the personality, even in the smallest ways.
